title: Enterprise Connectivity: monthly correction object identity
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this monthly correction object identity rule to corrected monthly transfer assessment.

## Basis: selected authorization
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, the assisted payout cycle handles the latest pending refund authorization on the selected holding by occurrence time; its latest timestamp must be unique, and its exact request identifier fixes the authorization throughout this cycle.

## Basis: selected assessment
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, read related-review reference from that exact pending refund authorization to identify the rate-error review; unrelated historical reviews are not selected.

## Basis: selected original charge
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, read source-event reference from that exact rate-error review to identify the original charge; the authorization's source payment must also refer to this same charge.

## Basis: source billing month
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, read period from the exact original posted charge; a review's recorded period cannot replace the charge's billing period.

## Basis Q&A
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment: Read period from the exact original posted charge | a review's recorded period cannot replace the charge's billing period. |
